description: A day after Ohio’s second primary, the candidates vying for the state’s 64th House District are already looking ahead to November. Vince Peterson, II, won the Democrat primary Tuesday. He received more than 68% of the vote. Peterson will face Republican Nick Santucci in the General Election…
paid_for_by: PAID FOR BY FRIENDS OF NICK SANTUCCI
title: WKBN: Candidates ready to face off for Ohio’s 64th District — Nick Santucci for State Representative
